Remix_Dance Music is a series of works that is designed to be a musical interface for improvisation, which allows a performer to create a musical structure by displacing and transforming sound materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an improvisatory sound displacing system, which is based on the MPEG-7 audio features and realized with the Max/MSP software.
we have created a new type of musical interface that can be used to create new types of music.
we have been exploring the potentialities of the audio descriptors for music improvisation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a touch screen-based interface can be a viable option to realize a quasi-fixed tape piece.
a quasi-fixed piece can be a valuable tool for improvisers to explore the potential of sound displacement.
a sound-displacing interface can be used as a musical instrument, where the performer’s role is to create and shape musical structures out of a given pool of sound materials.
